prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent isometric city sprite for an existing modern strategy game. Create ONE coherent compact miniature city district inspired by Kyiv in its intact prewar architectural appearance, not a current documentary view. Orthographic isometric view from above at 35 degrees, same scale and lighting for whole set, soft daylight from upper left. A small thin roughly diamond-shaped ground footprint with streets and sparse trees, not a tall plinth. Entire district isolated with genuinely transparent background and generous 8 percent margin on all sides. Centered full object, no crop, no horizon or sky, no backdrop, no cast shadow outside footprint. 5-8 carefully arranged buildings with one clear local landmark, coherent geography compressed artistically. No texts, labels, lettering, flags, borders, UI, watermarks, people, weapons, war damage, fantasy buildings, giant symbolic objects or floating parts. Square image. CITY DETAILS: Kyiv, Ukraine. Architectural focus: Saint Sophia Cathedral with white walls, green roofs and modest gold cupolas and its separate Ukrainian baroque bell tower; a small cluster of warm cream Khreshchatyk mid-rise blocks, one contemporary blue-gray office building, a leafy park. Cathedral is a real solid church with correctly seated domes, not floating symbols.
